mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Broad functional recovery would need a developmental endpoint; the strand is held at abstention because no drug has been applied to a Wwox system for any myelin endpoint and the sign of the activity-myelin relationship in this genotype is unmeasured.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: Pro-myelinating agents (muscarinic-antagonist class such as clemastine and benztropine, thyroid-hormone and antipsychotic routes) and, as a separate question, activity manipulation as a myelin lever.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the Wwox-deficient oligodendrocyte lineage is itself the limiting compartment, which the neuron-versus-oligodendrocyte genetic arms argue against. Transfer unmeasured.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: N-13 stands. New: the earlier record (DL-MECH-031 point 2) proposed that reducing seizure load might itself improve myelination because myelination is activity-dependent. The best-matched non-WWOX datum points the other way for a seizing network: Knowles 2022, Nat Neurosci (PMID 35501379, abstract read; absence-seizure models, not WWOX) reports that seizure-driven activity increases oligodendrogenesis and myelination in the seizure network, is prevented by seizure suppression, and that blocking activity-dependent myelination lowers seizure burden. The Wwox-null brain is hypomyelinated despite bursting, so neither simple sign is established. Also found: the 'near-complete MBP rescue' of the neuronal AAV is image-only (DA-W2-011).
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE if ever; broad recovery needs the developmental endpoint.
p4_card.mechanism: Target (if pursued): oligodendrocyte differentiation or the axon-oligodendrocyte activity signal. Direction wanted: more compact myelin. The causal compartment is neuronal, so a drug acting on oligodendrocytes alone is not expected to reach the cause.

external_not_wwox_evidence: Saab 2016 Neuron (PMID 27292539), title only: oligodendroglial NMDA receptors and axonal energy metabolism

for: Myelin is reduced in the knockout and activity-dependent myelination exists in other systems.
against: Oligodendrocyte-lineage deletion shows no anomaly while neuronal deletion reproduces it.
The oligodendrocyte-promoter AAV arm gave no detectable protein, so it neither supports nor refutes oligodendroglial relevance.
In a seizure network, activity drives maladaptive myelination in the other-disease precedent: suppressing activity may lower or raise myelin depending on the system; the sign here is unmeasured.
Oligodendroglial NMDA receptors support axonal energy metabolism in the other-disease precedent, so chronic NMDAR block (F01) has a myelin-side cost that is unmeasured.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Absence-seizure and healthy-brain systems; adult versus neonatal; no Wwox arm.

p4_card.pharmacology: Not assessed: no compound is carded.

p4_card.predictions: Registered: if hypomyelination is driven by loss of an axonal signal, an oligodendrocyte-directed compound leaves it unchanged in Wwox-deficient neurons and corrects it only after neuronal restoration; if activity raises myelin in this genotype, chronic suppression lowers MBP; if activity suppression helps, MBP rises. The three outcomes are separable by one chronic-suppression arm and one activity-raising arm against vehicle.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-null (or conditional neuronal) mice or co-cultures; arms: vehicle, chronic activity suppression, activity-raising manipulation, one pro-myelinating agent; controls: wild type with the same arms, neuronal-restoration positive control; endpoints: quantified MBP and g-ratio by electron microscopy, oligodendrocyte counts; discriminating result: the direction of the myelin change under suppression versus under activity.
p4_card.value_added: Records that the seizure-load-improves-myelin inference was an assumption with a counter-precedent, and that the neuronal rescue's myelin evidence is image-level.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried.
directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
Every disease-side row from the Drosophila article is NOT WWOX-DEE EVIDENCE; the organoid rows are exploratory transcript analyses of one deposit.
Abstract-level statements from PubMed are labelled abstract_only; none carries a receipt.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED in the bridge: the bridge has no network. The openFDA adapter was run separately and is recorded in lucas_clarke_followup_20261026/compounds_and_sources.md.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; assay concentrations of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.

abstention_card.missing_datum: A quantified myelin endpoint in a Wwox-deficient system after any pro-myelinating compound or any chronic activity manipulation; never done.
abstention_card.search_record: PubMed 2026-10-27: WWOX with oligodendrocyte and remyelination returned nothing; WWOX with myelin returned nine records, none a pro-myelinating drug arm; Knowles 2022 found by a targeted query.
